# Munther AlHajjar (منذر الحجار)

> Media Project Manager & Business Development, based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. 9+ years working where media meets commerce: evaluating opportunities, preparing tenders and proposals, negotiating with partners and suppliers, and overseeing delivery on quality, cost and schedule through contract closure — across real estate, media, exhibitions, marketing and strategic partnerships.

## Key numbers
- 9+ years of experience
- 100+ projects managed
- 17+ strategic contracts closed
- 48% sales growth
- 350+ products managed with 94% client satisfaction

## Expertise
- Project management & governance: planning to closure, budget, quality and timeline control
- Business development & contracting: RFP creation, bidding/tenders, negotiation, B2B partnerships
- Procurement & systems: documented procure-to-pay cycle, supplier management, SAP ERP (MM), Bitrix24
- Media, branding & real estate marketing and launches

## Experience
